name: FA_BALANCES_EXTRACT
description: This table contains data for asset balances subject area.

columns.name: BALANCES_EXTRACT_ID
columns.description: Row number in the balances extract table.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Name of the asset book for which data is extracted.

columns.name: PERIOD_COUNTER
columns.description: Depreciation period identification number.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Name of the period for which data is extracted.

columns.name: SOURCE_TABLE
columns.description: Table from which each row is extracted.

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_TYPE
columns.description: Identifies the source of the row extracted.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger to which asset book is associated.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the extracted line.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Unique asset identification number.

columns.name: ASSET_TYPE
columns.description: Asset with specific characteristics. The asset types allowed are Capitalized, Construction-in-Process, Expensed, and Group.

columns.name: GROUP_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Group asset identification number.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Number that identifies the asset category.

columns.name: CATEGORY_BOOK_DEFAULT_ID
columns.description: Default depreciation rules for the category in the book.

columns.name: UNITS_ASSIGNED
columns.description: Number of units assigned to the distribution.

columns.name: TOTAL_UNITS
columns.description: Total number of units assigned to the asset.

columns.name: UNIT_RATIO
columns.description: Ratio of the units to total units.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Unique asset distribution identifier.

columns.name: DIST_CCID
columns.description: Depreciation expense account identifier.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Location flexfield identification number.

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_ID
columns.description: Employee identification number used to assign an asset to an employee.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Unique asset transaction identifier.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code used to identify the type of asset transaction  performed.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_KEY
columns.description: General class of transaction. Possible values are R for retirements, UA for unplanned depreciation amortized from current period, and UE for unplanned depreciation expensed.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Asset accounting line identifier.

columns.name: SOURCE_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique asset source line identifier.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code used to identify the transaction type of the accounting line.

columns.name: SOURCE_DEST_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates whether the line is on the source or destination side of a transaction.

columns.name: DEPRN_RUN_ID
columns.description: Depreciation submission identifier.

columns.name: DEPRN_RUN_DATE
columns.description: System date when depreciation was run.

columns.name: DEPRN_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Source from which the depreciation record was created. Possible values are B(BOOKS), D(DEPRN), and T(TRACK).

columns.name: ACCOUNT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of account this row affects.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: Balance account identifier based on account type.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount broken down by the account type and asset distribution.

columns.name: BEGINNING_BALANCE
columns.description: Total amount of the account type at the start of the period.

columns.name: AE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Transaction accounting entry identifier.

columns.name: AE_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Number that is associated with each subledger journal entry line.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Categorization of accounting events that is unique within an application and event class.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event type and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Short name of a lookup type that is shared across applications used to classify journal entry lines.

columns.name: MASS_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique mass transaction identifier.

columns.name: GL_SL_LINK_ID
columns.description: Audit trail from the subledger application to the general ledger.

columns.name: GL_SL_LINK_TABLE
columns.description: Subledger link table name. This column is used to link general ledger journal  lines with subledger journal entry lines.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_ENTRY_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status code of the accounting entry.

columns.name: GL_TRANSFER_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: General Ledger transfer status code.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
